lines.text: Then versus now. Getting ready for the first freeze.
Then. I was twenty two. The first freeze meant a cute hat and hot chocolate on the porch.
Now. My phone screamed freeze watch at six, and my husband ran outside in a bathrobe.
The pipes, Tamsin. The pipes do not care about your hat.
He is holding a sock.
It is a faucet sock. Everybody gets a sock.
Then a sock was for feet. Now a sock is a lifestyle.
He put socks on me too. Four, actually.
Pepper, you love the cold. You used to eat snow.
Then, I was a puppy. I ate snow. I ate a mitten. I ate part of the fence.
Now, I am eleven. I eat dinner at four thirty and I go to bed.
Step two. We drip the faucets all night.
Then, I left the faucet running because I forgot.
Now we do it on purpose. Like adults.
I check it at two, four and six. The drip needs me.
It made a little sound at four. Like, thank you, Dale.
That was me. I was drinking from the toilet.
Okay. Step three. The plants come inside.
Then, I had one cactus named Steve. He asked for nothing.
Now we have forty one plants. And one of them talks.
Excuse me. I am not a plant. I am a lemon tree.
Lady Lemon gets the good window.
The south window, with the morning light. I am from a warm place, darling.
She is from the garden center by the highway.
A warm garden center.
She has been growing that one lemon since two thousand nineteen.
Good things take time. Like my lemon.
The car. Then, I scraped the windshield with my library card.
Now, he starts the car twenty minutes early and sits in it.
I warm the seats for the family. I am the seat warmer.
Then he was a husband. Now he is a heated seat.
And every window gets a blanket. Every door gets a towel snake.
Six towel snakes. Larry, Barry, Mary, and three Garys.
This is too much. When I was twenty two, winter was fun. We were fun.
Were we?
Yes. I have a video from twenty years ago. Watch.
There I am. Cute hat. Hot chocolate on the porch.
And who is that behind me. In a bathrobe.
Is that me, wrapping the faucet in a sock?
You were twenty three!
He was never young. He was born forty five.
Then, I made you that hot chocolate. With the little marshmallows.
Wait. You made the hot chocolate?
Then and now. I just stand behind you with a sock.
Dale. That is kind of beautiful.
I am crying. It is lemon juice. It stings.
Oh. My phone just buzzed. Update. The freeze watch is canceled.
Canceled?
Low of forty one. It is not even going to freeze.
Oh no.
Forty one plants, six towel snakes, and a sock on the faucet.
I am not going back outside. I live here now.
Then, we would put everything back.
Now, we leave it all out until the real one.
Next Tuesday.
I am going to bed. It is four thirty.
